title.zh: 卷一百四十五 列傳第三十二: 亦憐真班 廉惠山海牙 月魯不花 達禮麻識理
title.en: Volume 145 Biographies 32: Yilianzhenban, Lianhuishanhaiya, Yuelubuhua, Dalimashili
title.raw: 卷一百四十五 列傳第三十二: 亦憐真班 廉惠山海牙 月魯不花 達禮麻識理 Volume 145 Biographies 32: Yilianzhenban, Lianhuishanhaiya, Yuelubuhua, Dalimashili

sentences.zh: 亦憐真班

translations.literal: Yilianzhenban
translations.idiomatic: Yilianzhenban

sentences.zh: 亦憐真班，西夏人。

translations.literal: Yilianzhenban was a man of Western Xia.
translations.idiomatic: Yilianzhenban was a native of Western Xia.

sentences.zh: 父俺伯，以忠勤事世祖，為知樞密院事。

translations.literal: His father Anbo, serving Emperor Shizu with loyalty and diligence, became Associate Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: His father Anbo served Emperor Shizu with loyal diligence and was appointed associate director of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 亦憐真班性剛正，動有禮法。

translations.literal: Yilianzhenban's nature was upright and firm; in his conduct he always observed ritual and law.
translations.idiomatic: Yilianzhenban was upright by nature and conducted himself with constant regard for ritual propriety.

sentences.zh: 仁宗召見，令入宿衛。

translations.literal: Emperor Renzong summoned him for an audience and ordered him to enter the palace guard.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Renzong received him in audience and had him enrolled in the imperial guard.

sentences.zh: 延祐六年，超拜翰林侍講學士、中奉大夫。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Yanyou, he was promoted in one step to Hanlin Attending Lecturer and Palace Attendant of the Third Rank.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year of the Yanyou era (1319), he was promoted at a stroke to Hanlin Attending Lecturer and Palace Attendant of the Third Rank.

sentences.zh: 至治二年，調同知通政院事，擢虎符唐兀親軍都指揮使。

translations.literal: In the second year of Zhizhi, he was transferred to Vice Director of the Office for Regulation of Communications, and promoted to Commander-in-Chief of the Tangut Imperial Guard with the Tiger Tallies.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of the Zhizhi era (1322), he was made vice director of the Office for Regulation of Communications and promoted to commander-in-chief of the Tangut Imperial Guard bearing the tiger tallies.

sentences.zh: 泰定初，遷資善大夫、典瑞院使。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Taiding era, he was transferred to Grand Master for the Good of the State and Director of the Office of Imperial Regalia.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Taiding reign, he was promoted to Grand Master for the Good of the State and made director of the Office of Imperial Regalia.

sentences.zh: 天歷二年，以選為太子家令，尋升資政大夫、同知樞密院事，擢侍御史，仍兼指揮使。

translations.literal: In the second year of Tianli, by selection he became Director of the Household of the Heir Apparent; soon he was raised to Grand Master for Governance and made Associate Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs, promoted to Censor-in-Chief, while still retaining his command.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of the Tianli era (1329), he was chosen as director of the heir apparent's household; he was soon raised to Grand Master for Governance and appointed associate director of the Bureau of Military Affairs and censor-in-chief, while retaining his military command.

sentences.zh: 至順初，拜翰林學士承旨、榮祿大夫，遷功德使，指揮使如故。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Zhishun, he was appointed Hanlin Academician Expositor-in-Chief and Grand Master for Splendid Happiness, transferred to Commissioner of Meritorious Achievement, his commandership remaining as before.
translations.idiomatic: At the opening of the Zhishun era (1330), he was appointed Hanlin Academician Expositor-in-Chief and Grand Master for Splendid Happiness, then made commissioner of meritorious achievement while keeping his command.

sentences.zh: 尋出為陝西行省平章政事，未行，復為翰林學士承旨。

translations.literal: Soon he went out as Pacification Commissioner of the Shaanxi Branch Secretariat; before he departed, he was again made Hanlin Academician Expositor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon sent out as pacification commissioner of the Shaanxi Branch Secretariat, but before he could take up the post he was reappointed Hanlin Academician Expositor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 元統、至元之間，伯顏為丞相，專權擅政，嫉其論事不阿，出為江南行台御史大夫。

translations.literal: Between the Yuantong and Zhiyuan eras, Bayan served as chief councillor, monopolizing power and acting arbitrarily; resenting that Yilianzhenban would not flatter him in debate, he had him sent out as Regional Censor-in-Chief of the Jiangnan Surveillance Commission.
translations.idiomatic: During the Yuantong and Zhiyuan periods, Bayan was chief councillor and wielded power despotically; because Yilianzhenban would not bend in council, Bayan had him posted as regional censor-in-chief of the Jiangnan Surveillance Commission.

sentences.zh: 尋殺其子答裡麻，而謫置海南。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he had Yilianzhenban's son Dalima killed and banished Yilianzhenban himself to Hainan.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he had Yilianzhenban's son Dalima put to death and banished Yilianzhenban to Hainan.

sentences.zh: 及伯顏敗，乃得召還朝。

translations.literal: When Bayan fell, Yilianzhenban was at last summoned back to court.
translations.idiomatic: After Bayan's downfall, he was finally recalled to the capital.

sentences.zh: 至正六年，拜光祿大夫、御史大夫，盡遷中外廉能之官置諸風憲，一時號稱得人。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Zhizheng, he was appointed Grand Master for Splendid Illumination and Censor-in-Chief; he moved every incorrupt and capable official inside and outside the court into the surveillance offices, and for a time the appointments were acclaimed as well chosen.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year of Zhizheng (1346), he was made Grand Master for Splendid Illumination and censor-in-chief; he transferred every upright and capable official throughout the empire into the surveillance service, and for a time the appointments were hailed as excellent.

sentences.zh: 遷宣政院使，出為甘肅行省平章政事，設法弭西羌之寇，民賴以安，立石頌之。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Director of the Bureau of Buddhist and Tibetan Affairs, then sent out as Pacification Commissioner of the Gansu Branch Secretariat; he devised measures to quell raids by the Western Qiang, and the people relied on him for security; a stone was erected in his praise.
translations.idiomatic: He became director of the Bureau of Buddhist and Tibetan Affairs, then went out as pacification commissioner of the Gansu Branch Secretariat; he devised measures to suppress Western Qiang incursions, the people were secured under his rule, and a commemorative stone was raised in his honor.

sentences.zh: 召還，為銀青榮祿大夫、知樞密院事，提調太醫院，尋加金紫光祿大夫，復為御史大夫、知經筵事，兼宣忠斡羅思扈衛親軍指揮使。

translations.literal: Recalled, he was made Grand Master for Splendid Happiness with Silver Seal and Associate Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs, with charge of the Imperial Medical Academy; soon he was given the additional title Grand Master for Splendid Illumination with Gold Seal, again made Censor-in-Chief and Director of the Classics Lectures, while also serving as Commander of the Oros Guard Imperial Guard.
translations.idiomatic: On recall he was appointed Grand Master for Splendid Happiness with the silver seal and associate director of the Bureau of Military Affairs, with supervisory charge of the Imperial Medical Academy; he soon received the additional rank of Grand Master for Splendid Illumination with the gold seal, was again made censor-in-chief and director of the classics lectures, and concurrently commanded the Oros Guard Imperial Guard.

sentences.zh: 嘗奏言：「風俗人心日趨於薄，請禁故吏不許彈劾所事官長。」

translations.literal: He once memorialized: "Customs and the human heart grow daily more shallow; I request that former subordinates be forbidden to impeach the officials they once served."
translations.idiomatic: He once submitted: "Popular morals and men's hearts grow thinner by the day; I ask that former clerks be barred from impeaching the superiors they once served."

sentences.zh: 太師馬扎兒台與子丞相脫脫既謫居在外，時相欲傾之，嗾人告變，且扳台臣同上奏。

translations.literal: Grand Preceptor Maqa'altai and his son, Chief Councillor Toghto, having already been demoted and living in exile, the incumbent chief councillor wished to destroy them; he incited men to report a plot and also dragged other high ministers into a joint memorial.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Preceptor Maqa'altai and his son Chief Councillor Toghto, already demoted and living abroad, were targeted by the reigning chief councillor, who stirred up accusations of treason and pulled other ministers into a joint memorial against them.

sentences.zh: 亦憐真班曰：「凡為相者，孰無閑退之日？

translations.literal: Yilianzhenban said: "Whoever serves as chief councillor—who does not have a day of retirement?"
translations.idiomatic: Yilianzhenban said, "Every man who has been chief councillor must someday leave office—who does not?"

sentences.zh: 況脫脫父子在官無大咎過，奈何迫之於險？

translations.literal: Moreover, father and son Toghto committed no great fault in office—why drive them into peril?"
translations.idiomatic: Besides, Toghto and his father committed no grave fault in office—why press them into danger?"

sentences.zh: 」終不從。

translations.literal: " In the end the court would not agree.
translations.idiomatic: " The court would not heed him in the end.

sentences.zh: 經筵進講必詳必慎，故每讀譯文，必被嘉納。

translations.literal: In advancing lectures at the classics mat he was always thorough and careful; therefore whenever he read the translated text he was sure to be commended and accepted.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever he lectured at the classics mat he was exhaustive and meticulous, so that each time he read the translated text the emperor praised and accepted his exposition.

sentences.zh: 監察御史劾奏時相，帝不聽，亦憐真班反覆論奏不已，由是忤上意，出為江浙行省平章政事，遷拜湖廣行省左丞相。

translations.literal: When investigating censors memorialized against the chief councillor, the emperor would not listen; Yilianzhenban argued back and forth in memorial after memorial without cease, and thereby offended the emperor's wishes; he was sent out as Pacification Commissioner of the Jiangsu-Zhejiang Branch Secretariat and then promoted to Left Chief Councillor of the Huguang Branch Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: When surveillance censors impeached the chief councillor, the emperor refused to hear them; Yilianzhenban pressed his arguments in repeated memorials until he offended the throne, was sent out as pacification commissioner of the Jiangsu-Zhejiang Branch Secretariat, and was then promoted to left chief councillor of the Huguang Branch Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 復召知樞密院事。

translations.literal: He was again summoned as Associate Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: He was recalled and again made associate director of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 十一年，潁、亳兵起，朝廷命將出師，多失律致敗，數進言於時相，不見聽，復出為江浙行省左丞相。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, rebellion broke out at Ying and Bo; the court ordered generals to take the field, but many violated discipline and were defeated; he repeatedly advised the chief councillor, was not heeded, and was again sent out as Left Chief Councillor of the Jiangsu-Zhejiang Branch Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year (1351) armies rose at Ying and Bo; the court sent generals forth, but many broke discipline and were beaten; he urged the chief councillor again and again without being heard, and was once more posted as left chief councillor of the Jiangsu-Zhejiang Branch Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 十二年，移江西行省左丞相。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year he was transferred to Left Chief Councillor of the Jiangxi Branch Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year he was transferred to left chief councillor of the Jiangxi Branch Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 於是妖寇由蘄、黃陷饒州，饒之屬邑安仁與龍興相接境，其民皆相挺為亂。

translations.literal: Thereupon demonic bandits from Qi and Huang overran Raozhou; Anren, a subordinate county of Raozhou, bordered Longxing, and its people all rose together in revolt.
translations.idiomatic: Then rebel forces from Qi and Huang seized Raozhou; Anren, a county under Raozhou, adjoined Longxing, and the people there rose in concert.

sentences.zh: 亦憐真班道出安仁，因駐兵招之，來者厚加賞賚，不從者命子哈藍朵兒只與江西左丞火你赤等乘高縱火攻散之。

translations.literal: Yilianzhenban was passing through Anren on his route and therefore halted his troops to summon them; those who came were richly rewarded, while those who refused he ordered his son Qarandorji and the Jiangxi Left Councillor Huonichi and others to attack from the heights with fire and scatter them.
translations.idiomatic: Yilianzhenban's route took him through Anren, where he halted his troops to summon the rebels; those who came were richly rewarded, while those who refused he had his son Qarandorji, the Jiangxi left councillor Huonichi, and others attack from high ground with fire and break them up.

sentences.zh: 餘乾久為盜區，亦聞風順服。

translations.literal: Yugan had long been a haunt of bandits; they too, hearing the news, submitted peacefully.
translations.idiomatic: Yugan had long been a bandit stronghold; hearing of him, they too submitted peacefully.

sentences.zh: 先是，江西行省平章政事道童以寬容為政，軍民懈馳。

translations.literal: Earlier, the Jiangxi Branch Secretariat's Pacification Commissioner Daotong had governed with indulgence, and troops and people grew slack.
translations.idiomatic: Previously the Jiangxi pacification commissioner Daotong had ruled with excessive leniency, and both soldiers and civilians had grown lax.

sentences.zh: 亦憐真班既至，風采一新，威聲大振，所在群盜咸謀歸款矣。

translations.literal: Once Yilianzhenban arrived, his bearing was wholly renewed and his prestige greatly shaken; bandits everywhere plotted to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: When Yilianzhenban arrived, discipline was wholly renewed and his authority resounded; bandits throughout the region began to seek terms of surrender.

sentences.zh: 十四年八月，以疾卒於官，所部為之喪氣。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the fourteenth year he died of illness in office, and the districts under him lost heart.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the fourteenth year (1354) he died of illness in office, and the regions under his command were cast into despondency.

sentences.zh: 事聞，贈推忠佐運正憲秉義同德功臣，追封齊王，謚忠獻。

translations.literal: When word reached the court, he was posthumously enfeoffed as Duke of Qi with the posthumous title Zhongxian and given the title of meritorious minister who supports loyalty, assists the dynasty, upholds the correct statutes, and shares the same virtue.
translations.idiomatic: On report to the court he was posthumously enfeoffed as Duke of Qi with the posthumous title Loyal and Offering, and granted the honorific of meritorious minister who supports loyalty, assists the dynasty, upholds correct statutes, and shares the same virtue.

sentences.zh: 子九人：長答裡麻；

translations.literal: He had nine sons: the eldest Dalima;
translations.idiomatic: He had nine sons. The eldest was Dalima;

sentences.zh: 次普達失理，翰林學士承旨、知制誥兼修國史；

translations.literal: the second Pudadashili, Hanlin Academician Expositor-in-Chief, Drafter of Imperial Edicts, and Compiler of National History;
translations.idiomatic: the second, Pudadashili, Hanlin Academician Expositor-in-Chief, drafter of imperial edicts, and compiler of national history;

sentences.zh: 桑哥八剌，同知青海宣慰司事；

translations.literal: Sanggabala, Vice Commissioner of the Qinghai Pacification Commission;
translations.idiomatic: Sanggabala, vice commissioner of the Qinghai Pacification Commission;

sentences.zh: 哈藍朵兒只，宣政院使；

translations.literal: Qarandorji, Director of the Bureau of Buddhist and Tibetan Affairs;
translations.idiomatic: Qarandorji, director of the Bureau of Buddhist and Tibetan Affairs;

sentences.zh: 桑哥答思，嶺北行省平章；

translations.literal: Sanggadas, Pacification Commissioner of the Lingbei Branch Secretariat;
translations.idiomatic: Sanggadas, pacification commissioner of the Lingbei Branch Secretariat;

sentences.zh: 沙嘉室理，嶺北行省參政；

translations.literal: Shajiashili, Vice Councillor of the Lingbei Branch Secretariat;
translations.idiomatic: Shajiashili, vice councillor of the Lingbei Branch Secretariat;

sentences.zh: 易納室理，大宗正也可扎魯火赤；

translations.literal: Yinashili, yeke jarquchi of the Grand Council of the Imperial Clan;
translations.idiomatic: Yinashili, senior jarquchi of the Grand Council of the Imperial Clan;

sentences.zh: 馬的室理，僉書樞密院事；

translations.literal: Madeshili, Vice Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs;
translations.idiomatic: Madeshili, vice director of the Bureau of Military Affairs;

sentences.zh: 馬剌室理，內八府宰相。

translations.literal: Malashili, Minister of the Eight Palaces.
translations.idiomatic: and Malashili, minister of the Eight Palaces.

sentences.zh: ○廉惠山海牙

translations.literal: ○ Lian Huishanhaiya
translations.idiomatic: ○ Lian Huishanhaiya

sentences.zh: 廉惠山海牙，字公亮，布魯海牙之孫，希憲之從子也。

translations.literal: Lian Huishanhaiya, style Gongliang, was the grandson of Buluhaia and nephew of Xian.
translations.idiomatic: Lian Huishanhaiya, whose style was Gongliang, was the grandson of Buluhaia and a nephew of Xian.

sentences.zh: 父阿魯渾海牙，廣德路達魯花赤。

translations.literal: His father Aruqunhaiya was darughachi of Guangde Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: His father Aruqunhaiya served as darughachi of Guangde Circuit.

sentences.zh: 惠山海牙幼孤，言及父，輒泣下。

translations.literal: Huishanhaiya was orphaned young; whenever he spoke of his father he would weep.
translations.idiomatic: Huishanhaiya lost his father in childhood; whenever he spoke of him he wept.

sentences.zh: 獨養母而家日不給，垢衣糲食，不以為恥。

translations.literal: He alone supported his mother while the household daily lacked provisions; in filthy clothes and coarse food he was not ashamed.
translations.idiomatic: He supported his mother alone while the household went wanting day by day; he wore patched clothes and ate coarse fare without shame.

sentences.zh: 母喪，哀毀逾禮，負喪渡江而風濤作，舟人以神龍忌屍為言，即仰天大呼曰：「吾將附母于先人，神奈何厄我也！

translations.literal: When his mother died, his grief exceeded the rites; bearing the coffin he crossed the river, and wind and waves rose; the boatmen said the dragon god abhorred a corpse aboard—he immediately cried heavenward: "I am about to lay my mother with the ancestors—how can the spirits thwart me!"
translations.idiomatic: At his mother's death his mourning exceeded the prescribed rites; as he ferried the coffin across the river a storm arose, and the boatmen said the dragon god forbade a corpse aboard—whereupon he cried to Heaven, "I mean to lay my mother beside my forefathers—how can the spirits obstruct me!"

sentences.zh: 」風遂止。

translations.literal: " The wind then ceased.
translations.idiomatic: " The wind fell at once.

sentences.zh: 年弱冠，大臣欲俾入宿衛。

translations.literal: In his weak youth, great ministers wished to have him enter the palace guard.
translations.idiomatic: While still in his early youth, senior ministers wished to enroll him in the palace guard.

sentences.zh: 辭曰：「吾大父事世祖，以通經號廉孟子。

translations.literal: He declined, saying: "My great-grandfather served Emperor Shizu and was styled Master Lian for his mastery of the classics.
translations.idiomatic: He declined, saying, "My great-grandfather served Emperor Shizu and was known as Master Lian for his command of the classics.

sentences.zh: 今方設科取士，願讀書以科第進。

translations.literal: Now the court is setting examinations to select scholars; I wish to study and advance by the examination route."
translations.idiomatic: The court is now holding examinations to choose scholars; I wish to study and advance by earning a degree."

sentences.zh: 」乃入國學積分。

translations.literal: He then entered the National University to accumulate points.
translations.idiomatic: He thereupon entered the National University to accumulate examination points.

sentences.zh: 至治元年，登進士第，授承事郎、同知順州事。

translations.literal: In the first year of Zhizhi he passed the jinshi examination and was appointed Junior Gentleman and Vice Magistrate of Shun Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Zhizhi (1321) he passed the jinshi examination and was appointed junior gentleman and vice magistrate of Shun Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 有弓匠提舉馬都剌者，怙勢奪州民田，同列畏之。

translations.literal: There was an archery artisan superintendent named Madusi who relied on power to seize the prefecture's people's fields; his colleagues feared him.
translations.idiomatic: An archery-artisan intendant named Madusi used his influence to seize the people's fields; his colleagues were afraid of him.

sentences.zh: 惠山海牙至，即治其事。

translations.literal: When Huishanhaiya arrived, he immediately prosecuted the matter.
translations.idiomatic: When Huishanhaiya took office, he prosecuted the case at once.

sentences.zh: 在官期年，用薦者召入史館，預修英宗、仁宗《實錄》，尋拜監察御史。

translations.literal: After one year in office, by recommendation he was summoned into the History Office to help compile the Veritable Records of Emperors Yingzong and Renzong, and soon was appointed Investigating Censor.
translations.idiomatic: After a year in office he was recommended into the History Office to help compile the Veritable Records of Emperors Yingzong and Renzong, and was soon made investigating censor.

sentences.zh: 時中書省有大臣貪猥狼籍，即抗章劾之，語同列曰：「儻以言責獲罪，吾之職也。

translations.literal: At that time a great minister of the Central Secretariat was greedy and dissolute beyond measure; he immediately submitted a stern memorial of impeachment, telling his colleagues: "If I am punished for speaking as duty requires, that is my office."
translations.idiomatic: At that time a senior minister of the Central Secretariat was grossly corrupt; he submitted a forceful impeachment, telling his colleagues, "If I am punished for speaking as my office requires, so be it."

sentences.zh: 」既又劾奏明裡董阿不當攝祭太廟。

translations.literal: " He also memorialized that Mingli Dong'a should not perform the rites of imperial sacrifice at the Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: " He also impeached Mingli Dong'a for improperly officiating at sacrifices in the Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 遷都水監，疏會通河，堤灤、漆二水，又修京東閘。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Director of Waterways, dredged the Tonghui Canal, embanked the Luan and Qi rivers, and also repaired the eastern capital sluice gates.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to director of waterways, dredged the Tonghui Canal, built embankments on the Luan and Qi rivers, and repaired the sluice gates of the eastern capital.

sentences.zh: 歷秘書丞、會福總管府治中，上疏言二月迎佛費財蠹俗，時論韙之。

translations.literal: He served as Secretary Director and Administrator of the Huifu Directorate, and memorialized that the second-month Buddha-welcoming ceremony wasted wealth and corrupted custom; contemporaries approved.
translations.idiomatic: He served as secretary director and administrator of the Huifu Directorate, and memorialized that the second-month ceremony of welcoming the Buddha wasted resources and debased custom—a view contemporaries endorsed.

sentences.zh: 出僉淮東廉訪司事，遷江浙行省左右司員外郎，既而歷僉河東、河南、江西廉訪司事，升江南行御史臺經歷。

translations.literal: He went out as Vice Commissioner of the Huaidong Surveillance Commission, was transferred to Left and Right Department Vice Director of the Jiangsu-Zhejiang Branch Secretariat, and afterward served in succession as vice commissioner of the Hedong, Henan, and Jiangxi surveillance commissions, then was promoted to Secretary of the Jiangnan Regional Surveillance Commission.
translations.idiomatic: He was sent out as vice commissioner of the Huaidong Surveillance Commission, became left and right department vice director of the Jiangsu-Zhejiang Branch Secretariat, then served in turn as vice commissioner of the Hedong, Henan, and Jiangxi surveillance commissions before rising to secretary of the Jiangnan Regional Surveillance Commission.

sentences.zh: 時山東鹽法大壞，以選除都轉運使，曾未期月，用課最，賞賚金幣、上尊。

translations.literal: At that time the Shandong salt laws were greatly corrupted; by selection he was made Director-General of Transport; within less than a year, by the highest revenue returns, he was rewarded with gold coins and imperial wine.
translations.idiomatic: The Shandong salt monopoly was then in grave disorder; he was chosen director-general of transport, and within a year, on the strength of the highest revenue returns, was rewarded with gold coins and imperial wine.

sentences.zh: 至正三年初，行郊禮，召拜侍儀使。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the third year of Zhizheng, when suburban rites were performed, he was summoned and appointed Master of Ceremonies.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the third year of Zhizheng (1343), when suburban rites were held, he was summoned and made master of ceremonies.

sentences.zh: 明年，預修遼、金、宋三史，遷崇文太監。

translations.literal: The next year he helped compile the histories of Liao, Jin, and Song, and was transferred to Director of the Hall for the Veneration of Culture.
translations.idiomatic: The following year he helped compile the histories of Liao, Jin, and Song and was transferred to director of the Hall for the Veneration of Culture.

sentences.zh: 自是累遷為河南行省右丞。

translations.literal: From then he was repeatedly promoted to Right Chief Councillor of the Henan Branch Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter he rose in stages to right chief councillor of the Henan Branch Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 時有詔發民治決河，遍騷屬郡，亟以不便上言，而時宰不用。

translations.literal: At that time an edict mobilized the people to repair the breached Yellow River, disturbing every subordinate commandery; he urgently memorialized that it was impracticable, but the chief councillors would not use his advice.
translations.idiomatic: An edict then conscripted the people to repair the breached Yellow River, throwing every subordinate prefecture into turmoil; he urgently argued that the plan was unworkable, but the chief councillors ignored him.

sentences.zh: 遷湖廣行省右丞，以武昌失守連坐，既而事白，遷江西行省右丞。

translations.literal: Transferred to Right Chief Councillor of the Huguang Branch Secretariat, he was implicated when Wuchang fell and was later cleared; he was moved to Right Chief Councillor of the Jiangxi Branch Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Transferred to right chief councillor of the Huguang Branch Secretariat, he was punished when Wuchang was lost, though later exonerated, and was moved to right chief councillor of the Jiangxi Branch Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 時所隸郡縣多陷於賊，乃與平章政事、司徒道童協謀殫力，以定守禦招捕之策，就除本道廉訪使。

translations.literal: Most subordinate prefectures and counties had fallen to bandits; he joined Pacification Commissioner and Minister Daotong in concerted effort to fix policies of defense and recruitment, and was thereupon appointed surveillance commissioner of this circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Most counties and prefectures under his jurisdiction had fallen to rebels; he and the pacification commissioner and minister Daotong worked together to settle policies of defense and recruitment, and was then appointed surveillance commissioner of the circuit.

sentences.zh: 未幾，江西省治亦陷，惠山海牙遁往福建。

translations.literal: Before long the Jiangxi provincial seat also fell; Huishanhaiya fled to Fujian.
translations.idiomatic: Soon the Jiangxi provincial capital fell as well; Huishanhaiya escaped to Fujian.

sentences.zh: 久之，除僉江浙行樞密院事，改拜福建行省右丞，以兵鎮延平、邵武，境內以寧。

translations.literal: After a long interval he was appointed Vice Director of the Jiangsu-Zhejiang Branch Bureau of Military Affairs, then made Right Chief Councillor of the Fujian Branch Secretariat, holding troops at Yanping and Shaowu so that the territory was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: After a long interval he was made vice director of the Jiangsu-Zhejiang Branch Bureau of Military Affairs, then right chief councillor of the Fujian Branch Secretariat; he garrisoned Yanping and Shaowu and brought the region to peace.

sentences.zh: 居歲餘，奉詔還治省事，總備禦事，且督賦稅由海道供京師，朝廷賴焉。

translations.literal: After more than a year he was ordered back to manage provincial affairs, oversee defense preparations, and supervise taxes shipped by sea route to the capital; the court relied on him.
translations.idiomatic: After more than a year he was ordered back to direct provincial government, oversee defense, and supervise grain taxes sent by sea to the capital; the court depended on him.

sentences.zh: 遷行宣政院使。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Acting Director of the Bureau of Buddhist and Tibetan Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to acting director of the Bureau of Buddhist and Tibetan Affairs.

sentences.zh: 明年，拜翰林學士承旨、知制誥兼修國史。

translations.literal: The next year he was appointed Hanlin Academician Expositor-in-Chief, Drafter of Imperial Edicts, and Compiler of National History.
translations.idiomatic: The following year he was appointed Hanlin Academician Expositor-in-Chief, drafter of imperial edicts, and compiler of national history.

sentences.zh: 卒，年七十有一。

translations.literal: He died at seventy-one.
translations.idiomatic: He died at the age of seventy-one.

sentences.zh: ○月魯不花

translations.literal: ○ Yuelubuhua
translations.idiomatic: ○ Yuelubuhua

sentences.zh: 月魯不花，字彥明，蒙古遜都思氏。

translations.literal: Yuelubuhua, style Yanming, of the Mongol Xundusi clan.
translations.idiomatic: Yuelubuhua, style Yanming, was of the Mongol Xundusi clan.

sentences.zh: 生而容貌魁偉，咸以令器期之。

translations.literal: From birth his appearance was imposing; all regarded him as a man of promise.
translations.idiomatic: From childhood his bearing was imposing, and everyone expected great things of him.

sentences.zh: 未冠，父脫帖穆耳以千戶職戍越，因受業於韓性先生，為文下筆立就，粲然成章。

translations.literal: Before he capped his years, his father Tutmishur was garrisoning Yue as commander of a thousand; he therefore studied under Master Han Xing and could compose essays at a stroke, brilliant and fully formed.
translations.idiomatic: Before he came of age his father Tutmishur was stationed in Yue as commander of a thousand; he studied under Master Han Xing and wrote essays at a stroke, polished and complete.

sentences.zh: 就試江浙鄉闈，中其選，居右榜第一。

translations.literal: He sat for the Jiangsu-Zhejiang provincial examination and was chosen, ranking first on the right list.
translations.idiomatic: He took the Jiangsu-Zhejiang provincial examination, passed, and ranked first on the right list.

sentences.zh: 方揭曉，試官夢月中有花象，已而果符其名，人以為異。

translations.literal: Just as the results were posted, an examiner dreamed of flowers in the moon like an elephant; afterward it indeed matched his name, and people thought it strange.
translations.idiomatic: When the results were posted, an examiner dreamed of flowers in the moon like an elephant; afterward the dream matched his name, and people marveled.

sentences.zh: 遂登元統元年進士第，授將仕郎、台州路錄事司達魯花赤。

translations.literal: He then passed the jinshi in the first year of Yuantong and was appointed Awaiting Appointment Gentleman and darughachi of the Taizhou Circuit Records Office.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi in the first year of Yuantong (1333) and was appointed awaiting-appointment gentleman and darughachi of the Taizhou Circuit records office.

sentences.zh: 縣未有學，乃首建孔子廟，既又延儒士為之師，以教後進。

translations.literal: The county had no school; he first built a temple to Confucius, then invited Confucian scholars as teachers to instruct the younger generation.
translations.idiomatic: The county had no school; he first built a Confucian temple, then invited scholars to teach the younger generation.

sentences.zh: 丁外艱。

translations.literal: He mourned his father.
translations.idiomatic: He entered mourning for his father.

sentences.zh: 至正元年，朝廷立行都水監，以選為其監經歷。

translations.literal: In the first year of Zhizheng the court established the Metropolitan Waterworks Office; by selection he became its secretary.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Zhizheng (1341) the court established the Metropolitan Waterworks Office, and he was chosen its secretary.

sentences.zh: 尋擢廣東廉訪司經歷。

translations.literal: Soon he was promoted to Secretary of the Guangdong Surveillance Commission.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon promoted to secretary of the Guangdong Surveillance Commission.

sentences.zh: 會廷議將治河決，以行都水監丞召之，比至，改集賢待制，除吏部員外郎。

translations.literal: When the court deliberated on repairing the Yellow River breach, he was summoned as Vice Director of the Metropolitan Waterworks Office; before he arrived he was changed to Attendant of the Hall of Assembled Worthies and appointed Vice Director of the Ministry of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: When the court debated repairing the Yellow River breach he was summoned as vice director of the Metropolitan Waterworks Office; before he arrived he was made attendant of the Hall of Assembled Worthies and vice director of the Ministry of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 奉命至江浙糴粟二十四萬石，至則第戶產之高下，以為糴之多寡，不擾而事集。

translations.literal: Ordered to purchase 240,000 piculs of grain in Jiangsu-Zhejiang, on arrival he ranked households by the height of their means as the measure of how much each should sell, and the task was completed without disturbance.
translations.idiomatic: Ordered to purchase 240,000 piculs of grain in Jiangsu-Zhejiang, he classified households by wealth to set purchase quotas and finished the task without harassing the people.

sentences.zh: 既而軍餉不給，又奉命出糴於江浙，召父老諭曰：「今天子宵衣旰食，惟恐澤不下民而民不得其所耳，然奈盜賊何。

translations.literal: Soon military provisions were insufficient, and he was again ordered to purchase grain in Jiangsu-Zhejiang; he summoned the elders and addressed them: "The Son of Heaven rises early and retires late, fearing only that blessings may not reach the people and the people may not find their place—yet what can be done about bandits?"
translations.idiomatic: When army rations ran short he was again ordered to buy grain in Jiangsu-Zhejiang; he called the elders and said, "The Son of Heaven rises before dawn and retires after dark, fearing only that grace may not reach the people and they may not live in peace—yet what can be done about bandits?"

sentences.zh: 夫討賊者必先糧餉，以我不汝擾，故命我復來，蓋討賊即所以安民耳。

translations.literal: To attack bandits one must first have provisions; because I do not trouble you, I am sent again—attacking bandits is precisely how to secure the people."
translations.idiomatic: To fight bandits one must first have rations; because I have not troubled you, I am sent again—suppressing bandits is itself how the people are kept secure."

sentences.zh: 父老其謂何？

translations.literal: What do the elders say?"
translations.idiomatic: What do you elders say?"

sentences.zh: 」眾咸應曰：「公言是也。

translations.literal: The crowd all answered: "Your words are right."
translations.idiomatic: All answered, "Your words are right."

sentences.zh: 」不逾月，糧事以畢。

translations.literal: " Within a month the grain business was finished.
translations.idiomatic: " Within a month the grain purchases were complete.

sentences.zh: 丁母憂，中書遣賻且起復，不應。

translations.literal: He mourned his mother; the Central Secretariat sent condolence gifts and ordered him to resume office, but he would not accept.
translations.idiomatic: He mourned his mother; the Central Secretariat sent funeral gifts and ordered him back to office, but he refused.

sentences.zh: 未幾，太師、右丞相脫脫南征，辟從軍事，督饋餉，饋餉用舒。

translations.literal: Before long Grand Preceptor and Right Chief Councillor Toghto marched south; Yuelubuhua was recruited for military affairs to supervise provisions, and the supply of provisions went smoothly.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Grand Preceptor and Right Chief Councillor Toghto marched south; Yuelubuhua was recruited to supervise supplies, and provisions flowed without hindrance.

sentences.zh: 升吏部郎中，尋拜監察御史。

translations.literal: He was promoted to Director of the Ministry of Personnel and soon appointed Investigating Censor.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to director of the Ministry of Personnel and soon made investigating censor.

sentences.zh: 首上疏言：「郊廟禮甚缺，天子宜躬祀南郊，殷祭太室。

translations.literal: He first memorialized: "Suburban and ancestral rites are greatly deficient; the Son of Heaven should personally sacrifice at the southern suburb and perform the Yin sacrifice in the Grand Chamber."
translations.idiomatic: His first memorial said, "Suburban and ancestral rites are gravely neglected; the Son of Heaven should sacrifice in person at the southern suburb and perform the Yin rite in the Grand Chamber."

sentences.zh: 」繼又上疏言：「皇太子天下之本，當簡老成重臣為輔導，以成其德。

translations.literal: He then memorialized again: "The heir apparent is the root of the empire; elder statesmen of weight should be chosen to guide him, that his virtue may be formed."
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized again: "The heir apparent is the foundation of the realm; grave and seasoned ministers should be chosen to tutor him so his virtue may mature."

sentences.zh: 」帝皆嘉納之。

translations.literal: The emperor commended and accepted both.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor praised and accepted both memorials.

sentences.zh: 升吏部侍郎，銓選於江浙，時稱其公允。

translations.literal: He was promoted to Vice Director of the Ministry of Personnel and conducted selections in Jiangsu-Zhejiang; at the time he was praised as fair.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to vice director of the Ministry of Personnel and conducted civil-service selections in Jiangsu-Zhejiang, where he was acclaimed for fairness.

sentences.zh: 適朝廷有建議欲於河間、長蘆置局造海船三百艘者，月魯不花即為書具言其非便。

translations.literal: Just then the court had a proposal to establish offices at Hejian and Changlu to build three hundred seagoing vessels; Yuelubuhua immediately wrote a memorial setting forth in detail why it was impracticable.
translations.idiomatic: When the court proposed establishing offices at Hejian and Changlu to build three hundred seagoing ships, Yuelubuhua at once memorialized in detail why the plan was unworkable.

sentences.zh: 言入中書，忤議者，遷工部侍郎。

translations.literal: When the memorial reached the Central Secretariat, it offended the proponents, and he was transferred to Vice Director of the Ministry of Works.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial reached the Central Secretariat, offended those behind the proposal, and he was transferred to vice director of the Ministry of Works.

sentences.zh: 後分部彰德，道過河間，民遮擁拜謝曰：「微公言，吾民其斃矣。」

translations.literal: Later, while assigned to Zhangde, he passed through Hejian; the people blocked his path, bowing and thanking him, saying: "But for your words, our people would have perished."
translations.idiomatic: Later, on duty in Zhangde, he passed through Hejian, where the people thronged about him bowing and saying, "But for your memorial, our people would have been ruined."

sentences.zh: 會方重選守令，以保定密邇京畿，除保定路達魯花赤。

translations.literal: At that time the court was again selecting prefects and magistrates; because Baoding lay close to the capital region, he was appointed darughachi of Baoding Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: The court was then reappointing prefects and magistrates; because Baoding lay near the capital region, he was made darughachi of Baoding Circuit.

sentences.zh: 陛辭，詔諭諄切。

translations.literal: On audience for leave, the edict admonished him earnestly.
translations.idiomatic: At his farewell audience the emperor admonished him with especial earnestness.

sentences.zh: 保定歲輸糧數十萬石於新鄉，苦弗便。

translations.literal: Baoding yearly transported several hundred thousand piculs of grain to Xinxiang, which was painfully inconvenient.
translations.idiomatic: Baoding each year shipped several hundred thousand piculs of grain to Xinxiang, a burden the people found intolerable.

sentences.zh: 月魯不花請輸京倉以便之。

translations.literal: Yuelubuhua requested that the grain be delivered to the capital granaries for convenience.
translations.idiomatic: Yuelubuhua asked that the grain be sent instead to the capital granaries for the people's ease.

sentences.zh: 俄除吏部尚書。

translations.literal: Soon he was appointed Director of the Ministry of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon appointed director of the Ministry of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 保定父老百數詣闕，言乞留監郡以撫吾民，遂以尚書仍知郡事。

translations.literal: Several hundred elders of Baoding went to the court, asking that he be kept to oversee the commandery and comfort their people; he was therefore made Director while still governing the commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Several hundred Baoding elders petitioned the throne to keep him governing the commandery; he was therefore left as director of personnel while continuing to administer the prefecture.

sentences.zh: 會賊北渡河，日修城浚濠為戰守具。

translations.literal: When bandits crossed the Yellow River from the north, he daily repaired walls and dredged moats as preparations for defense.
translations.idiomatic: When rebels crossed the Yellow River from the north, he daily repaired the walls and deepened the moats for defense.

sentences.zh: 廷議發五省八衛軍出戍外鎮，月魯不花疏願留其兵護本郡，遂兼統黑軍數千人及團結西山八十二寨民義軍，勢大張。

translations.literal: The court deliberated sending troops of five provinces and eight guards to garrison outer posts; Yuelubuhua memorialized asking to retain those troops to protect his commandery, and thereby also took command of several thousand Black Army troops and militia from the eighty-two stockaded villages of the western hills, so that his power greatly expanded.
translations.idiomatic: The court planned to send troops from five provinces and eight guards to garrison distant posts; Yuelubuhua memorialized to keep those troops for his commandery, took command of several thousand Black Army soldiers and militia from eighty-two western hill stockades, and his strength grew greatly.

sentences.zh: 賊再侵境，皆不利，遁去。

translations.literal: The bandits invaded the border twice, met ill fortune both times, and fled.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels invaded twice, were beaten both times, and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 升中奉大夫，錫上尊四、馬百匹，僚佐增秩有差，別降宣敕俾賞有功者。

translations.literal: He was promoted to Palace Attendant of the Third Rank, granted four jars of imperial wine and a hundred horses, his subordinates promoted in varying degrees, and a separate edict was sent down to reward those who had merit.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to palace attendant of the third rank, rewarded with four jars of imperial wine and a hundred horses, his subordinates promoted in varying degrees, and a separate edict authorized rewards for the meritorious.

sentences.zh: 召還為詳定使。

translations.literal: Recalled, he became Commissioner for Detailed Determination.
translations.idiomatic: On recall he was made commissioner for detailed determination.

sentences.zh: 保定民不忍其去，繪像以祀之。

translations.literal: The people of Baoding could not bear his departure and painted his image for worship.
translations.idiomatic: The people of Baoding could not bear to see him go and painted his portrait for veneration.

sentences.zh: 去保定一月而城陷矣。

translations.literal: One month after he left Baoding, the city fell.
translations.idiomatic: A month after he left Baoding, the city was lost.

sentences.zh: 朝廷以月魯不花夙負民望，令入城招諭之，抵城，賊堅壁不出，民多竊出謁拜者。

translations.literal: The court, because Yuelubuhua had long enjoyed the people's esteem, ordered him to enter the city and summon them to submission; he reached the city, but the bandits shut their gates and would not come out, while many people stole out to bow to him in secret.
translations.idiomatic: Because Yuelubuhua had long enjoyed the people's trust, the court ordered him into the fallen city to win the people back; the rebels barred the gates, yet many townspeople slipped out to bow to him in secret.

sentences.zh: 改大都路達魯花赤。

translations.literal: He was changed to darughachi of the Dadu Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to darughachi of the Dadu Circuit.

sentences.zh: 有執政以故中書令耶律楚材先塋地冒奏與蕃僧為業者，月魯不花格之，卒弗與。

translations.literal: A chief councillor falsely memorialized that the former grave lands of the late Central Secretariat Director Yelü Chucai should be given to Tibetan monks as their property; Yuelubuhua blocked it and in the end would not grant it.
translations.idiomatic: A chief councillor falsely memorialized to grant the former grave lands of the late Central Secretariat director Yelü Chucai to Tibetan monks; Yuelubuhua blocked the grant and in the end refused.

sentences.zh: 轉吏部尚書。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Director of the Ministry of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to director of the Ministry of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 會劇賊程思忠據永平，其佐雷帖木兒不花偽降，事覺被擒，殺之，思忠壁守遂益堅。

translations.literal: At that time the fierce bandit Cheng Sizhong held Yongping; his lieutenant Lei Temür Buhua feigned surrender, but when the plot was discovered he was seized and killed, and Sizhong's walled defense grew all the firmer.
translations.idiomatic: The fierce rebel Cheng Sizhong held Yongping; his lieutenant Lei Temür Buhua pretended to surrender, was discovered, seized, and executed, and Sizhong's defense grew only firmer.

sentences.zh: 詔令月魯不花招撫之，眾悉難其行，月魯不花毅然曰：「臣死君命，分也，奈何先計禍福哉！

translations.literal: An edict ordered Yuelubuhua to summon them to submission; all thought the mission perilous, but Yuelubuhua said resolutely: "A minister dies for his lord's command—that is his portion; how can one first reckon fortune and disaster!"
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Yuelubuhua to win them by persuasion; everyone thought the errand perilous, but he said firmly, "A minister dies for his sovereign's command—that is his lot; how can one first calculate profit and loss!"

sentences.zh: 」竟入城諭賊，賊皆感泣羅拜納降。

translations.literal: " He finally entered the city and admonished the bandits; they all wept, bowed in ranks, and submitted.
translations.idiomatic: " He entered the city at last, admonished the rebels, and they wept, bowed in ranks, and surrendered.

sentences.zh: 還，遷翰林侍講學士，俄復為大都路達魯花赤。

translations.literal: On return he was transferred to Hanlin Attending Lecturer, and soon again made darughachi of the Dadu Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: On his return he was made Hanlin Attending Lecturer, and soon again darughachi of the Dadu Circuit.

sentences.zh: 入見帝宣文閣，有旨若曰：「朕以畿甸之民疲敝，特選爾撫吾民。

translations.literal: Entering to see the emperor at the Hall for the Dissemination of Culture, he received an instruction as if to say: "I find the people of the capital region weary and impoverished and have specially chosen you to comfort my people.
translations.idiomatic: Received in audience at the Hall for the Dissemination of Culture, he was told, "I find the people of the capital region worn and impoverished and have specially chosen you to govern them.

sentences.zh: 爾毋峻威，毋弛法，或挾權以乾汝於非法，其即以聞。

translations.literal: Do not be harsh in authority, do not relax the laws; if anyone uses power to interfere with you unlawfully, report it at once."
translations.idiomatic: Do not be harsh in authority, do not relax the laws; if anyone abuses power to wrong you unlawfully, report it at once."

sentences.zh: 」視事之初，帝及皇后、皇太子皆遣使賜之酒。

translations.literal: " At the beginning of his administration the emperor, empress, and heir apparent all sent envoys to bestow wine on him.
translations.idiomatic: " At the start of his tenure the emperor, empress, and heir apparent each sent envoys with wine.

sentences.zh: 有權臣以免役事來謁，月魯不花面斥曰：「聖訓在耳，不敢違。

translations.literal: A powerful minister came to visit on a matter of exemption from corvée; Yuelubuhua rebuked him to his face: "The holy instruction is still in my ears—I dare not disobey."
translations.idiomatic: A powerful minister came seeking exemption from corvée labor; Yuelubuhua rebuked him to his face, "The sacred instruction is still in my ears—I dare not disobey."

sentences.zh: 」轉資善大夫，拜江南行御史臺中丞。

translations.literal: " He was transferred to Grand Master for the Good of the State and appointed Vice Censor-in-Chief of the Jiangnan Regional Surveillance Commission.
translations.idiomatic: " He was made Grand Master for the Good of the State and vice censor-in-chief of the Jiangnan Regional Surveillance Commission.

sentences.zh: 陛辭之日，帝御嘉禧殿慰勞之，且賜以上尊、金幣；

translations.literal: On the day of his farewell audience the emperor received him in the Jiaxi Hall to comfort him and also bestowed imperial wine and gold coins;
translations.idiomatic: On his farewell audience the emperor received him in the Jiaxi Hall, comforted him, and bestowed imperial wine and gold coins;

sentences.zh: 皇太子亦書「成德誠明」四大字賜之。

translations.literal: the heir apparent also wrote the four characters "Accomplished Virtue, Sincere Clarity" and bestowed them on him.
translations.idiomatic: the heir apparent also wrote the four characters Accomplished Virtue, Sincere Clarity and bestowed them on him.

sentences.zh: 月魯不花乃由海道趨紹興，為政寬猛不頗。

translations.literal: Yuelubuhua then went by sea route to Shaoxing; in government he was neither wholly lenient nor wholly severe.
translations.idiomatic: Yuelubuhua then traveled by sea to Shaoxing and governed with a balance of leniency and severity.

sentences.zh: 詔進階一品為榮祿大夫。

translations.literal: An edict advanced him one rank to Grand Master for Splendid Happiness.
translations.idiomatic: An edict advanced him one rank to Grand Master for Splendid Happiness.

sentences.zh: 既而除浙西肅政廉訪使。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he was appointed Surveillance Commissioner of Western Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon appointed surveillance commissioner of Western Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 會張士誠據浙西，僭王號，度弗可與並處，謂侄同壽曰：「吾家世受國恩，恨不能刺賊以報國，矧乃與賊同處邪！

translations.literal: When Zhang Shicheng held Western Zhejiang and usurped a royal title, judging that he could not dwell with him, he said to his nephew Tongshou: "Our house has received the state's grace for generations; I regret I cannot stab the bandit to repay the state—how much less dwell with the bandit!"
translations.idiomatic: When Zhang Shicheng seized Western Zhejiang and styled himself king, judging he could not remain, he told his nephew Tongshou, "Our family has received the dynasty's grace for generations; I regret I cannot stab the rebel to repay the state—how could I live beside him!"

sentences.zh: 」令同壽具舟載妻子，而匿身木櫃中，蔽以藳秸，脫走，至慶元。

translations.literal: " He had Tongshou prepare a boat to carry wife and children, while he hid himself in a wooden chest covered with straw and escaped to Qingyuan.
translations.idiomatic: " He had Tongshou prepare a boat for his wife and children while he hid in a wooden chest covered with straw and fled to Qingyuan.

sentences.zh: 士誠部下察知之，遣鐵騎百餘追至曹娥江，不及而返。

translations.literal: Zhang Shicheng's followers discovered it and sent more than a hundred iron cavalry in pursuit to the Cao'e River, but failed to overtake him and returned.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Shicheng's men discovered the ruse and sent more than a hundred armored horsemen in pursuit to the Cao'e River, but failed to overtake him.

sentences.zh: 俄改山南道廉訪使，浮海北而往，道阻，還抵鐵山，遇倭賊船甚眾，乃挾同舟人力戰拒之，倭賊紿言投降，弗納。

translations.literal: Soon he was changed to Surveillance Commissioner of the Shannan Circuit, went north by sea, found the route blocked, returned to Tieshan, and encountered a great host of Wokou ships; he then rallied those aboard to fight them off; the Wokou falsely offered surrender, and he would not accept.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon made surveillance commissioner of the Shannan Circuit and sailed north; the route blocked, he returned to Tieshan and met many Wokou ships; he rallied those aboard to fight them off, and when the Wokou feigned surrender he refused.

sentences.zh: 於是賊即登舟攫月魯不花，令拜伏，月魯不花罵曰：「吾朝廷重臣，寧為賊拜邪！

translations.literal: Thereupon the bandits boarded the ship and seized Yuelubuhua, ordering him to bow prostrate; Yuelubuhua cursed: "I am a great minister of the court—would I bow to bandits!"
translations.idiomatic: The pirates then boarded, seized Yuelubuhua, and ordered him to prostrate himself; he cursed, "I am a great minister of the court—would I bow to bandits!"

sentences.zh: 」遂遇害。

translations.literal: " He was thereupon killed.
translations.idiomatic: " He was killed on the spot.

sentences.zh: 當遇害時，麾家奴那海刺殺首賊。

translations.literal: At the time he was killed, he ordered his household slave Naha to stab and kill the chief bandit.
translations.idiomatic: As he was killed he ordered his household slave Naha to stab the pirate chief.

sentences.zh: 次子樞密院判官老安、侄百家奴捍敵，亦死之。

translations.literal: His second son, Associate Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs Lao'an, and his nephew Baijianu fought the enemy and also died.
translations.idiomatic: His second son, Bureau of Military Affairs associate director Lao'an, and his nephew Baijianu fought the enemy and died as well.

sentences.zh: 同舟死事者八十餘人。

translations.literal: More than eighty persons aboard the same boat died in the affair.
translations.idiomatic: More than eighty people aboard the same vessel died with him.

sentences.zh: 事聞，朝廷贈攄忠宣武正憲徇義功臣、銀青榮祿大夫、遼陽等處行中書省平章政事、上柱國，謚忠肅。

translations.literal: When word reached the court, he was posthumously enfeoffed as Grand Master for Splendid Happiness with Silver Seal, Pacification Commissioner of the Liaoyang Branch Secretariat, and Supreme Pillar of the State, with the posthumous title Zhongsu and the honorific of meritorious minister who displays loyalty, proclaims martial prowess, upholds correct statutes, and dies for righteousness.
translations.idiomatic: On report to the court he was posthumously made Grand Master for Splendid Happiness with the silver seal, pacification commissioner of the Liaoyang Branch Secretariat, and Supreme Pillar of the State, with the posthumous title Loyal and Solemn and the honorific of meritorious minister who displays loyalty, proclaims martial prowess, upholds correct statutes, and dies for righteousness.

sentences.zh: ○達禮麻識理

translations.literal: ○ Dalimashili
translations.idiomatic: ○ Dalimashili

sentences.zh: 達禮麻識理，字遵道，怯烈台氏。

translations.literal: Dalimashili, style Zundao, of the Qielietai clan.
translations.idiomatic: Dalimashili, style Zundao, was of the Qielietai clan.

sentences.zh: 其先北方大族，六世祖始居開平。

translations.literal: His ancestors were a great northern family; his sixth-generation ancestor first settled at Kaiping.
translations.idiomatic: His forebears were a great northern clan; his sixth-generation ancestor first settled at Kaiping.

sentences.zh: 父曰阿剌不花，江西行省參知政事，追封趙國公，謚襄惠。

translations.literal: His father was Alabuhua, Vice Councillor of the Jiangxi Branch Secretariat, posthumously enfeoffed as Duke of Zhao with the posthumous title Xianghui.
translations.idiomatic: His father Alabuhua was vice councillor of the Jiangxi Branch Secretariat, posthumously enfeoffed as Duke of Zhao with the posthumous title Xianghui.

sentences.zh: 達禮麻識理幼穎敏，從師授經史，過目輒領解。

translations.literal: Dalimashili was clever from youth; studying the classics and histories under teachers, he understood at a glance.
translations.idiomatic: Dalimashili was clever from childhood; taught the classics and histories, he understood whatever he read at a glance.

sentences.zh: 至正五年，經筵選充譯史，益自砥礪於學，搢紳先生皆以遠大期之。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Zhizheng, by selection at the classics mat he was made translator; he redoubled his effort in study, and gentry and teachers all expected great things of him.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of Zhizheng he was chosen as translator at the classics mat, redoubled his studies, and gentlemen and teachers alike expected great things of him.

sentences.zh: 轉補御史臺譯史，遂除御史臺照磨。

translations.literal: Transferred to fill a post as translator of the Surveillance Commission, he was then appointed Registrar of the Surveillance Commission.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to a translator's post at the Surveillance Commission and then made its registrar.

sentences.zh: 十五年，拜監察御史，出僉山北道肅政廉訪司事，未行，留為詹事院長史。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year he was appointed Investigating Censor and sent out as Vice Commissioner of the Shanbei Surveillance Commission, but before he departed he was retained as Secretary of the Household of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year he was made investigating censor and sent out as vice commissioner of the Shanbei Surveillance Commission, but before he left he was retained as secretary of the heir apparent's household.

sentences.zh: 俄遷工部員外郎，復留為長史。

translations.literal: Soon he was transferred to Vice Director of the Ministry of Works and again retained as secretary.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon transferred to vice director of the Ministry of Works and again kept as secretary.

sentences.zh: 明年，除中議，尋升參議詹事院事。

translations.literal: The next year he was appointed Middle Discussant, and soon promoted to Discussant of the Household of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: The following year he was made middle discussant, then promoted to discussant of the heir apparent's household.

sentences.zh: 十七年，為太子家令。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year he became Director of the Household of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year he became director of the heir apparent's household.

sentences.zh: 十八年，歷秘書太監、吏部侍郎、御史臺經歷、中書右司郎中。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year he served in succession as Secretary Director, Vice Director of the Ministry of Personnel, Secretary of the Surveillance Commission, and Director of the Right Department of the Central Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year he served in turn as secretary director, vice director of the Ministry of Personnel, surveillance secretary, and director of the right department of the Central Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 十九年，除刑部尚書，提調南北兵馬司巡綽事。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year he was appointed Director of the Ministry of Justice with charge of the patrol affairs of the Northern and Southern Military Horse Offices.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year he was made director of the Ministry of Justice with supervisory charge of patrol affairs in the northern and southern military horse offices.

sentences.zh: 盜逼畿甸，人心大恐。

translations.literal: Bandits pressed on the capital region and men's hearts were greatly afraid.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels pressed on the capital region and fear seized the people.

sentences.zh: 達禮麻識理能鎮之以靜，民恃以為安。

translations.literal: Dalimashili could calm them with quiet; the people relied on him and were secure.
translations.idiomatic: Dalimashili calmed them by his steadiness, and the people relied on him for security.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，由中書參議升中書參知政事、同知經筵事。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year he rose from Central Secretariat Discussant to Vice Councillor of the Central Secretariat and Associate Director of the Classics Lectures.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year he rose from Central Secretariat discussant to vice councillor of the Central Secretariat and associate director of the classics lectures.

sentences.zh: 二十三年冬，遷上都留守，兼開平府尹，加榮祿大夫，分司土嶺，東鎮三州，以督轉輸。

translations.literal: In the winter of the twenty-third year he was transferred to Defender of Shangdu, concurrently Magistrate of Kaiping Prefecture, with the added title Grand Master for Splendid Happiness, dividing supervision at Tuling and garrisoning the three eastern prefectures to oversee transport.
translations.idiomatic: In the winter of the twenty-third year he was made defender of Shangdu and concurrently magistrate of Kaiping Prefecture, with the added rank of Grand Master for Splendid Happiness, dividing supervision at Tuling and garrisoning three eastern prefectures to oversee transport.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，朝廷以前中書平章政事塔失帖木兒來為留守。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year the court sent the former Central Secretariat Pacification Commissioner Tashtemür to serve as defender.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year the court sent the former Central Secretariat pacification commissioner Tashtemür to be defender.

sentences.zh: 時孛羅帖木兒擁兵京師，而皇太子出居於外，達禮麻識理與塔世帖木兒皆以忠義許國，相與結人心以觀時變。

translations.literal: At that time Bolu Temür held troops in the capital while the heir apparent dwelt abroad; Dalimashili and Tashitemür both pledged loyal service to the state and together won men's hearts to watch how affairs would change.
translations.idiomatic: Bolu Temür then held troops in the capital while the heir apparent lived abroad; Dalimashili and Tashitemür both pledged loyal service and together won men's hearts to watch the turn of events.

sentences.zh: 未幾，改授塔世帖木兒為大司農。

translations.literal: Before long Tashitemür was reassigned as Director of the Directorate of Agriculture.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Tashitemür was reassigned director of the Directorate of Agriculture.

sentences.zh: 塔世帖木兒謂達禮麻識理曰：「我至京師則制於強臣，未易圖也。

translations.literal: Tashitemür said to Dalimashili: "If I reach the capital I shall be controlled by powerful ministers—not easy to act."
translations.idiomatic: Tashitemür told Dalimashili, "If I reach the capital I shall be controlled by powerful ministers and will not easily accomplish anything."

sentences.zh: 」因留不行。

translations.literal: " He therefore remained and did not go.
translations.idiomatic: " He therefore stayed and did not go.

sentences.zh: 適脫吉兒以孛羅帖木兒命屯兵蓋裡泊，托腹心於宗王也速也不堅，授以金印，俾駐上都之東郊，而以留守善安集兵於瓦吉剌部落。

translations.literal: Just then Toqir, by Bolu Temür's order, encamped troops at Gailipo, entrusted his intimate plans to the imperial prince Yesutubujian, gave him a gold seal, and had him garrison the eastern suburb of Shangdu, while the defender Shan'an assembled troops among the Ujigir tribes.
translations.idiomatic: Just then Toqir, on Bolu Temür's orders, encamped at Gailipo, entrusted his plans to the imperial prince Yesutubujian, gave him a gold seal to garrison the eastern suburb of Shangdu, while the defender Shan'an assembled troops among the Ujigir tribes.

sentences.zh: 達禮麻識理遇之有禮，善安辭去。

translations.literal: Dalimashili received him with courtesy, and Shan'an withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Dalimashili received him courteously, and Shan'an withdrew.

sentences.zh: 孛羅帖木兒復調帖木兒、托忽速哥至上都，以守禦為名，事益矛盾。

translations.literal: Bolu Temür again transferred Temür and Toqusko to Shangdu in the name of defense, and affairs grew more contradictory.
translations.idiomatic: Bolu Temür again transferred Temür and Toqusko to Shangdu under the pretext of defense, and tensions sharpened.

sentences.zh: 達禮麻識理與之周旋，略無幾微見於外，而密遣前宗正扎魯忽赤月魯帖木兒潛通音問於罕哈哈剌海行樞密知院益老答兒，請亟調兵南行。

translations.literal: Dalimashili dealt with them in public without the slightest sign, while secretly sending the former jarquchi of the Imperial Clan Council Yelü Temür with messages to Yisilaodar, Regional Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs at Hanhahala Sea, asking him to hurry troops south.
translations.idiomatic: Dalimashili dealt with them outwardly without the slightest sign, while secretly sending the former jarquchi of the Imperial Clan Council Yelü Temür to Yisilaodar, regional director of the Bureau of Military Affairs at Hanhahala Sea, urging him to march troops south at once.

sentences.zh: 又遣留守司照磨陳恭取兵興州，訪求在閒官吏之有才者，約束東西手八剌哈赤、虎賁司、糾集丁壯苗軍，火銃什伍相聯，一旦，布列鐵幡竿山下，揚言四方勤王之師皆至，帖木兒等大駭，一夕東走，其所將兵盡潰。

translations.literal: He also sent the defender's registrar Chen Gong to raise troops at Xingzhou, sought out talented officials at leisure, organized the eastern and western ba'erqachi, the Tiger Guard, and gathered militia and Miao troops; arquebus squads were linked in fives and tens; one day they were arrayed below Iron Banner Pole Hill, proclaiming that loyal armies from all quarters had arrived; Temür and the others were greatly terrified and fled east in one night, and the troops they led all collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: He also sent the defender's registrar Chen Gong to raise troops at Xingzhou, sought out talented officials at leisure, organized the eastern and western ba'erqachi and the Tiger Guard, gathered militia and Miao troops, and linked arquebus squads in fives and tens; one day they were drawn up below Iron Banner Pole Hill, proclaiming that loyal armies from every quarter had arrived; Temür and the others were terrified, fled east in a night, and their troops collapsed entirely.

sentences.zh: 由是達禮麻識理增修武備，城守益嚴。

translations.literal: Thereby Dalimashili increased military preparations and city defense grew stricter.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter Dalimashili strengthened the defenses and the garrison grew stricter.

sentences.zh: 二十五年，皇太子在冀寧，命立上都分省，達世帖木兒為平章政事，達禮麻識理為右丞，便宜行事，以固護根本。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year, with the heir apparent at Jining, the court ordered establishment of a branch secretariat at Shangdu; Tashitemür as Pacification Commissioner and Dalimashili as Right Councillor were to act as circumstances required to secure the foundation.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fifth year, with the heir apparent at Jining, the court established a branch secretariat at Shangdu; Tashitemür was pacification commissioner and Dalimashili right councillor, empowered to act as circumstances required to secure the dynastic foundation.

sentences.zh: 七月，禿堅帖木兒用孛羅帖木兒命，以兵犯上都，先遣利用少監帖裡哥赤至上都，令廣備糧餼，遠迓大軍。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, Tudjian Temür, by Bolu Temür's order, attacked Shangdu with troops; he first sent the Utilization Office Vice Director Teligeke to Shangdu ordering broad preparation of grain and fodder to welcome the great army from afar.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month Tudjian Temür, on Bolu Temür's orders, attacked Shangdu with troops; he first sent the Utilization Office vice director Teligeke to order broad preparation of grain and fodder to welcome the main army.

sentences.zh: 達禮麻識理開陳大義，戮之於市，民情乃定。

translations.literal: Dalimashili set forth the great principle and executed him in the market; the people's hearts were then settled.
translations.idiomatic: Dalimashili expounded the righteous cause and executed him in the market, whereupon the people's hearts were settled.

sentences.zh: 已而禿堅帖木兒帥鐵甲馬步軍蔽野而至，呼聲動天。

translations.literal: Before long Tudjian Temür led iron-clad cavalry and infantry covering the wilds; their shouts shook heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Tudjian Temür led iron-clad horse and foot soldiers covering the plain, their shouts shaking heaven.

sentences.zh: 達禮麻識理飭軍士城守，申明逆順之理以安人心，巡視城壁，晝夜不少息。

translations.literal: Dalimashili ordered the soldiers to defend the city, set forth the principle of right and wrong to calm hearts, and inspected the walls day and night without rest.
translations.idiomatic: Dalimashili ordered the garrison to defend the walls, explained the difference between loyalty and rebellion to calm the people, and inspected the ramparts day and night without rest.

sentences.zh: 夜遣死士縋城而下，焚其攻具，而調副留守禿魯迷失海牙引兵由小東門出，與之大戰臥龍岡，敗之。

translations.literal: At night he sent daredevils lowered by ropes from the wall to burn their siege engines, and ordered Vice Defender Tulushihaiya to lead troops out the small east gate to give great battle at Wolong Hill and defeat them.
translations.idiomatic: At night he sent daredevils down the walls by rope to burn the siege engines, and had vice defender Tulushihaiya lead troops out the small east gate to fight a great battle on Wolong Hill and defeat them.

sentences.zh: 未幾，孛羅帖木兒伏誅，禿堅帖木兒皆奔潰，而上都以安。

translations.literal: Before long Bolu Temür was executed, Tudjian Temür and the rest fled in rout, and Shangdu was secure.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Bolu Temür was executed, Tudjian Temür and the rest routed, and Shangdu was secure.

sentences.zh: 拜中書右丞，兼上都留守，提調虎賁司，加光祿大夫，賜黃金系腰，仍命提調東西手八剌哈赤。

translations.literal: He was appointed Right Councillor of the Central Secretariat, concurrently Defender of Shangdu, with charge of the Tiger Guard, given the added title Grand Master for Splendid Illumination and a gold belt, and still ordered to supervise the eastern and western ba'erqachi.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed right councillor of the Central Secretariat and concurrently defender of Shangdu, with charge of the Tiger Guard, promoted to Grand Master for Splendid Illumination with a gold belt, and still ordered to supervise the eastern and western ba'erqachi.

sentences.zh: 既而上都分省罷，遙授中書平章政事、上都留守，位居第一，力辭不允。

translations.literal: Soon the Shangdu branch secretariat was abolished; he was appointed in absentia Pacification Commissioner of the Central Secretariat and Defender of Shangdu, ranking first, but strenuously declined and was not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: When the Shangdu branch secretariat was abolished he was appointed in absentia pacification commissioner of the Central Secretariat and defender of Shangdu, ranking first, but he declined strenuously and was not allowed.

sentences.zh: 明年，召為大宗正府也可扎魯忽赤。

translations.literal: The next year he was summoned as yeke jarquchi of the Grand Council of the Imperial Clan.
translations.idiomatic: The following year he was summoned as senior jarquchi of the Grand Council of the Imperial Clan.

sentences.zh: 又明年，拜太子詹事。

translations.literal: The year after, he was appointed Director of the Household of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: The year after that he was appointed director of the heir apparent's household.

sentences.zh: 奉詔至軍中，宣明大義，籓將感悅。

translations.literal: Ordered to the army, he proclaimed the great principle, and frontier generals were moved and pleased.
translations.idiomatic: Ordered to the armies, he proclaimed the great principle, and frontier generals were moved and pleased.

sentences.zh: 遷翰林學士承旨。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Hanlin Academician Expositor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Hanlin Academician Expositor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 秋，除知樞密院事、大撫軍院事。

translations.literal: In autumn he was appointed Associate Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs and Director of the Great Pacification Army Office.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn he was made associate director of the Bureau of Military Affairs and director of the Great Pacification Army Office.

sentences.zh: 初，大撫軍院之立，皇太子用完者帖木兒、答爾麻、帖林沙、伯顏帖木兒、李國鳳等計，專以備禦擴廓帖木兒，既而政權不一，事務益乖，各復引去，而達禮麻識理之至，事且無可為者。

translations.literal: At first, when the Great Pacification Army Office was established, the heir apparent used the plan of Wanzhu Temür, Da'erma, Tielinsha, Bayan Temür, Li Guofeng, and others, solely to guard against Köke Temür; afterward governmental authority was not unified, affairs grew more at odds, each withdrew again, and when Dalimashili arrived there was nothing that could be done.
translations.idiomatic: When the Great Pacification Army Office was first established, the heir apparent had relied on Wanzhu Temür, Da'erma, Tielinsha, Bayan Temür, Li Guofeng, and others specifically to guard against Köke Temür; afterward authority was divided, affairs fell further out of joint, each withdrew again, and by the time Dalimashili arrived there was nothing left to accomplish.

sentences.zh: 達禮麻識理之卒也，先一夕，怯薛官哈剌章者，阿兒剌氏阿魯圖孫也，夜夢太祖召見，語之曰：「我以勤勞取天下，以傳於妥歡帖睦爾。

translations.literal: At Dalimashili's death, on the previous night the keshig officer Halaqan, grandson of Arutu of the Arul clan, dreamed that Taizu summoned him and said: "I took the empire through hard labor and transmitted it to Toqan Timür.
translations.idiomatic: On the eve of Dalimashili's death the keshig officer Halaqan, grandson of Arutu of the Arul clan, dreamed that Taizu summoned him and said, "I won the empire through hard labor and passed it to Toqan Timür.

sentences.zh: 而愛猷識理達臘不克肖似，廢壞我家法，苟不即收圖，天命不可保矣。

translations.literal: Yet Ayurshiridarada does not resemble him, has ruined my house laws—if he does not immediately recover the design, the Mandate cannot be preserved."
translations.idiomatic: Yet Ayurshiridarada does not take after him and has ruined my house laws—if he does not recover the design at once, the Mandate cannot be preserved."

sentences.zh: 爾吾功臣之後，且誠實，故召汝語，汝明旦亟以吾言告而主及愛猷識理達臘。

translations.literal: You are the descendant of my meritorious minister and moreover honest; therefore I summon you to speak—tomorrow morning urgently tell your lord and Ayurshiridarada my words."
translations.idiomatic: You are the descendant of my meritorious minister and are honest besides; therefore I summon you to speak—tomorrow morning tell your lord and Ayurshiridarada my words at once."

sentences.zh: 汝不以告，吾即殛汝，告而不改，則吾它有處之。

translations.literal: If you do not tell, I shall immediately punish you; if you tell and they do not reform, then I have other measures."
translations.idiomatic: If you do not tell, I shall punish you at once; if you tell and they do not reform, I have other measures."

sentences.zh: 達禮麻識理其人庶幾識事宜者，然知而不言，將焉用之？

translations.literal: Dalimashili is perhaps a man who understands affairs—yet knowing and not speaking, of what use is he?
translations.idiomatic: Dalimashili is perhaps one who understands affairs—yet knowing and not speaking, of what use is he?

sentences.zh: 吾其先殛之矣。

translations.literal: I shall punish him first."
